protocol.null_block_control: every feature arm carries a same-width all-NaN placebo; the effect of a feature is its paired delta against that placebo, because colsample_bytree re-draws the column subsample as soon as the matrix gets wider

alpha_definition.source: NBS Circular 514 sections 2.1 / 2.5, as transcribed by week 8
alpha_definition.column_naming_caveat: alpha_1e5 holds a*1e5 when alpha_kind == 'a'; it is a transcribed coefficient, not a derivative

conversion_check.note: the frozen column is written to the CSV with finite precision, so a non-zero max_abs_delta is first read as a serialisation limit; it is only a definition mismatch if it exceeds that limit

subsampling_control.cause: XGB_PARAMS pins colsample_bytree=0.8, which subsamples by column index; widening the matrix re-draws the subsample

reference_reproduction.protocol: band_room_only, grouped by InChIKey 10x5, frozen hybrid

verdict.temperature_dimension: alpha cannot serve it: the coefficient covers 0.0% of the v1.x room-band compound pool, so the arm reads a feature matrix whose every added cell is missing, and the empirical slope that would cover everything is only obtainable by fitting on the scored rows themselves.
verdict.compound_coverage: alpha is a coverage asset, not a temperature asset: it is available for 18.6% of the v1.0 pool
verdict.recommendation: do not add alpha to the v1.x feature block; keep the harmonised column as an external sanity band for the temperature dimension and revisit only if the compound roster is widened to the NBS family
